packages.title: The reminders question skips replaced messages and tab switches
brief: Context: P55 (round 2) made `_ask` in App/lib/widgets/reminder_ask_sheet.dart:49-109 wait for the form's route and then the save message, skip after Deshacer (`:63-65`) and skip when the screen under the form is no longer current (`:67`). The reviewer verified that (UX-439). Keep all of it, along with the sheet's copy and layout, the once-per-account rule, the `_askingProvider` slot handling in `finally` (`:107`) and `turnOnReminders`. Two gaps remain. Both are regressions of P55, and this is their first attempt.

UX-448 (S2; R2D-1, verified in code). `showFeedback` (App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart:13) calls `hideCurrentSnackBar()` before every new message. So when the newcomer ticks the task they just saved (`Tarea completada · Deshacer`, App/lib/widgets/task_interactions.dart:25-27) or moves its date (the date-changed message, task_interactions.dart:68-76) within about 4 s, the save message closes with `SnackBarClosedReason.hide`. `_ask` only stops on `action`, so it goes ahead, Calendar is still current, and the sheet opens at once over the new message's Deshacer, asking about a reminder for a task they just completed. Change `:61-65` so that once `bar` is non-null, the question goes ahead only when `await bar.closed` is `SnackBarClosedReason.timeout`, `.swipe` or `.dismiss`. For `action`, `hide` or `remove`, return; the existing `finally` releases the slot (`shown` is still false), so the next dated save asks. When `bar` is null, keep today's behaviour.

UX-449 (S1; R2D-2, inferred from code, needs a device check). The tabs are an IndexedStack inside one route (App/lib/screens/main_shell.dart:85-95), and each tab owns its Scaffold under the one ScaffoldMessenger. So after a save on Calendario, switching to Notas keeps the save message on screen until it times out, `under.isCurrent` (`:67`) stays true, and `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?` opens over Notas, where `antes` refers to nothing on screen. Fix it this way:

1. Create App/lib/providers/shell_tab_provider.dart with `final shellTabSwitchesProvider = StateProvider<int>((ref) => 0);` and a one-line doc comment: `Counts tab switches in the main shell, so a delayed question can tell the person moved on.` (StateProvider is already used, e.g. calendar_focus_provider.dart:13.)

2. In main_shell.dart:53 `onDestinationSelected`, when `index != _index`, increment it, e.g. `ProviderScope.containerOf(context, listen: false).read(shellTabSwitchesProvider.notifier).state++`, then `setState` as now. Write it only in this tap handler, never in build or initState (Riverpod forbids that). Tapping the tab already selected doesn't count. Leave everything else in main_shell.dart alone, including the label-scale code at :31-50, the destinations and the IndexedStack.

3. In `askAboutRemindersAfterSave`, read the count at the call, next to `under` (:39-45), and pass it to `_ask`. In `_ask`, right after the `under.isCurrent` check (:67), return when the count has changed; the slot is released as in UX-448. Use a count, not the tab index: routes open the shell on other tabs (main.dart:347-356), and a count needs no special case for them. Switching away and back also skips, and the next dated save asks.

4. Update the doc comment at :14-20: the question isn't asked when the person undid the save, moved to another screen or tab, or another message replaced the save message; the next dated save asks instead.

How this fits with later packages: P36-P38 move saves into the capture sheet, which passes its confirmation's controller as `feedback:`, and the same rules apply to it. The two-tab shell (U13) is still a pending decision. If it's built, the counter stays in its `onDestinationSelected`.
Don't touch: `showFeedback`, FeedbackTimeout, the callers in task_editor.dart and review_tasks_screen.dart, task_interactions.dart, the sheet's copy and layout. No new strings, so no ARB changes.
acceptance: Widget test (reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart): new account, reminders off, never asked, Spanish, Calendar tab. Save a dated task (Calendar's `Nueva tarea`, or the sheet that replaces it), then tick that task before the save message times out. `Tarea completada` and `Deshacer` are visible and hit-testable, and there is no BottomSheet. After that message times out, there is still no BottomSheet. A second dated save then shows `¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?` with `Sí, recuérdamelo` and `Ahora no` after its own message times out.
Widget test: same setup, but change the saved task's date before the save message times out. The date-changed message shows with no BottomSheet over it, and none appears after it closes.
Widget test: same setup, but swipe the save message away. The sheet appears (a swipe counts as seen).

Widget test: save a dated task on Calendario, then tap the Notas tab before the save message times out. After the timeout there is no BottomSheet on Notas. Back on Calendario, the next dated save asks once its message has closed.
Widget test: tapping the already-selected Calendario tab while the save message is showing doesn't stop the question. The sheet appears after the timeout.
The existing UX-401 and UX-439 tests in reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart still pass, including es and ca at 2× text on 320×568.
Code: `shellTabSwitchesProvider` is written only in main_shell.dart's `onDestinationSelected`.
deviceChecks: Fresh account, Spanish: save the first dated task on Calendario and switch to Notas within 4 s. No question appears on Notas. The next dated save on Calendario asks after its message goes.
Fresh account: tick the first dated task right after saving it. `Deshacer` on `Tarea completada` stays tappable, and no question appears.

packages.title: Calendar events retry keeps its line and shows progress
brief: Context: P52 (round 2) made the read-error line `No se pudieron leer los eventos. Toca para reintentar.` (key `calendarReadRetry`) try again on tap, and the reviewer verified it (UX-442). Keep that, the copy, and the access lines (`calendarDenied`, `calendarNoSelection`), which open /deviceCalendars. This is the first attempt at UX-447.

UX-447 (S1; R2B-1, inferred from code; a rare state). A retry tap collapses the line, so the content below jumps up 48 dp. If the read fails again quickly, the same line comes back and it looks as if nothing happened. There are two paths:

(a) the phone-calendar read (`state.error`, device_calendar_events.dart:36-38): `refresh()` resets the state to `access: checking` (App/lib/providers/device_calendar_provider.dart:136-137), and `:40-42` returns `SizedBox.shrink()`;
(b) the day's events read (`:53-55`): `ref.invalidate` puts the AsyncValue in loading, and with `skipLoadingOnRefresh: false` (`:50`) `loading` returns `SizedBox.shrink()` (`:52`).

Change: make `DeviceCalendarEvents` a `ConsumerStatefulWidget` with a private `_retrying` flag that only the two retry taps set. While `_retrying` is set and the read hasn't settled (path a: `state.access == CalendarAccess.checking`; path b: the day's AsyncValue `isLoading`), return the same `_EventsLine` with the same `calendarReadRetry` text, its `Icons.event_outlined` replaced by a `SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))` in the same `onSurfaceVariant` colour, and no tap (`onTap: null`, so a second tap can't start another read). Give `_EventsLine` an optional `busy` flag for this, and keep its 48 dp minimum height and padding.

Clear `_retrying` when the read settles: path a, `await` the notifier's `refresh()`; path b, `ref.invalidate(...)` and then `await ref.read(deviceEventsProvider(key).future)` with the error caught. Then `setState` if still mounted. If the retry fails, the normal retry line with the event icon comes back. If it succeeds, the event-count line shows, or nothing when the day has no events.

Unchanged on purpose: the first load and every other refresh (app resume, the provider's debounce at device_calendar_provider.dart:84, coming back from calendar choice) still show nothing while loading. Only a tapped retry keeps its place.
Don't touch: device_calendar_provider.dart, the ARB files (no new text), `_CalendarSheet`, `_startTime`, `deviceEventTime`.
acceptance: Widget test (device_calendar_ui_test.dart): Spanish, Calendar, with a phone-calendar fake whose calendars read fails twice. While the second read is pending after a tap on `No se pudieron leer los eventos. Toca para reintentar.`, `calendar-events-line` is still present at the same height as before the tap (at least 48 dp), shows a CircularProgressIndicator and no `Icons.event_outlined`, and the widget below it hasn't moved. After the second failure, the same text is back with the event icon.
Widget test: the same, but with the day's events read failing twice (the per-day error path).
Widget test: at 2× text on 320×568, in Spanish, the line's height during the retry equals its height before the tap.
Widget test: when the retry succeeds, the line shows the event count (`1 evento · …`) with the event icon and no progress indicator.
Widget test: on the first load, while access is still being checked, there is no events line and no progress indicator.
Code: no new ARB keys. device_calendar_provider.dart is unchanged.
